name: adhan-sft-v0-sangam
split_rule: stable poem-id hash; val_frac=0.10, test_frac=0.10, seed=42
licensing: Derived from the Open-Sangam corpus and its traditional commentaries; follow the upstream Open-Sangam licence. The 32 English eurai targets are Open-Sangam translations.
known_limits: Only 32 of 2,669 poems have a gold English eurai; do not treat sangam_eurai_en as a translation-quality claim.
314 poems have unknown tinai and are excluded from tinai-conditioned evaluation.
Where multiple task examples share a poem, the poem-level split keeps them on the same side; do not evaluate per-example across splits.
verification: stats.json reports zero poem overlap across train/val/test; the builder exits non-zero if any overlap is detected.
